purpose: Clean reproduction invokes the current fixed generator and writes a new prospective protocol. Historical Mac producer and packaging recovery remain archived unchanged.
prerequisites: cache/TSB-AD-U.zip exists and matches SHA256 0c47020d3423723c70773736dbd800369f2b487328becbf339450d1ae5020961; raw observations are not redistributed.
Fetch the 11 exact public source files listed by provenance/source-manifest.json into their listed repository-relative paths; preserve the upstream LICENSE and verify every hash.
Install detector dependencies in the calling interpreter or .cache/strengthening-env; generator probes imports before fitting and records the selected interpreter/package versions.
The fresh cache and two fresh receipt paths below must not exist; the generator refuses replacement.

ordered_commands.purpose: Verify current generator and retained historical artifacts before reproduction
argv: import hashlib,json;from pathlib import Path;r=Path.cwd();d=json.loads((r/'artifacts/pvldb-research-20261024/strengthening/workload-replay-descriptor.json').read_text());assert all(hashlib.sha256((r/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==h for p,h in d['source_sha256'].items());print('CURRENT_GENERATOR_AND_HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE_VERIFIED')

ordered_commands.purpose: Make the archived pinned dependency manifest available without overwriting a differing file
argv: import hashlib,json;from pathlib import Path;r=Path.cwd();b=r/'artifacts/pvldb-research-20261024/strengthening/provenance';m=json.loads((b/'mapping.json').read_text());e=next(e for e in m['entries'] if e['archive_path'].endswith('/source-manifest.json'));data=(r/e['archive_path']).read_bytes();assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==e['sha256'];p=r/'.cache/strengthening-tsbad/source-manifest.json';p.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);assert not p.exists() or p.read_bytes()==data;p.write_bytes(data) if not p.exists() else None;print('PINNED_SOURCE_MANIFEST_AVAILABLE')

ordered_commands.purpose: Generate once with the current fixed producer; protocol is written before the first detector fit

historical_mac_execution.explanation: The original Mac run completed all fits and native score serialization, then failed only at symlink-relative-path metadata construction. Archived source and recovery hashes preserve that chronology. Do not execute the historical producer or recovery on a clean rerun.

clean_new_run: Uses scripts/prepare_strengthening_workload.py, whose current hash is checked above and is pinned automatically into the new protocol. It includes the symlink-relative-path fix, so no packaging recovery is expected. New environment, file hashes and fit receipts must be retained as a new run; do not relabel them as the historical Mac execution.
downstream: Pass the fresh generation receipt to weighted_range_study.py freeze --inputs and build consumer protocol against that receipt. These commands do not execute metric timings.
immutability: This descriptor is auxiliary and was created after the historical workload. It does not change any existing discovery, protocol or generation manifest.
